Understands the structure of Earth
Note that the test may contain descriptions, visuals, or other examples along with the questions that relate to one or more of the topics. The test may also include definitional questions on the topics.

the three major types of rocks that make up Earth and how they are formed
Structure and properties of the hydrosphere (oceans)
the kinds of minerals contained in salt water
the physical features along the shore
the physical features beneath the surface of the oceans
bodies of water and their differences
Structure and properties of the atmosphere
how the atmosphere is structured in layers
the various gases that make up the atmosphere

Understands the unifying processes of science
A number of conceptual schemes and procedural schemes are used across all science disciplines.
These underlying principles are embodied in different ways in different disciplines (e.g., earth science, botany, medical research), but they transcend disciplinary boundaries and provide students with powerful ideas to help them understand the natural world.
